GenAI Public Knowledge Hub with filtering 
(LA)  
Infor GenAI is a Generative AI platform part of Infor OS that leverages 
Large Language Models (LLMs) for Natural Language Processing 
capabilities. The GenAI Public  Knowledge Hub is a capability 
within the GenAI Assistant to retrieve information from a diverse set of 
documents using Natural Language.
• Employees face several challenges 
when dealing with documentation. 
Searching through large, complex 
documentation can be time-consuming 
and frustrating, especially when users 
are unsure of the right terms or where to 
look.
• Users can quickly and efficiently retrieve the answers they need without having to search 
through an entire documentation source.
• The user experience becomes smoother, as the GenAI Assistant provides immediate and 
easy-to-understand responses.

Deep Agent and human in the loop (LA)
A GenAI assistant's effectiveness depends on three key factors: 
maintaining context during sessions, planning complex tasks, and 
executing them through agents. The main challenge with autonomous 
agents is that unclear instructions can lead to incorrect actions, wasted 
time, or misuse of tools. 
• GenAI Assistants repeatedly re-prompt for the 
same variables without persistent storage, 
context loss within sessions. 
• Multi-agent execution fails to pass outputs 
between agents, breaking complex workflows. 
• agent misinterpret vague instructions and 
execute irreversible, costly, or insecure actions 
without supervised validation. 
• Systems confirm action completion before 
backend execution finishes
• Improving the user experience while using the GenAI Assistant
• User is not forced to repeat the same information within a single session
• Improvements for the mutli-agent agents invocation
• Allowing the Agents to re-prompt whenever it is not certain about the action it should trigger OR whenever it is stated in 
the Agent instruction.
• Additional validation after Agent/Tool invocation by the Supervisor Agent to confirm that action has been successful 
All
GenAI
• Implementation of the Deep Agent: a planning tool, 
sub agents, access to a file system, and a detailed 
prompt.
• Deep Agents break down complex tasks into smaller 
steps while persisting state and context across tools.
• validates successful execution after each tool 
invocation
• Sensitive tools are not being executed without 
conformation

Inline Thoughts enhance the GenAI Assistant by providing clear,

• Users see how answers were reached, improving trust in the assistant.
• Conversations feel more natural, mirroring how people explain decisions to one another.

Custom Guardrails for Embedded Experience 
Custom Guardrails allows for providing rules for content moderation/ 
filtering on input and output content. It is configurable for GenAI 
embedded experience.
• The GenAI service may inadvertently generate 
or process harmful content as a result of 
hallucinations, which occur when the model 
produces information that is incorrect, 
misleading, or inappropriate based on user 
prompts. 
• Such risks include the dissemination of false 
facts, offensive language, or content that could 
negatively impact users or stakeholders. 
• Guardrails ensure the assistant provides reliable, appropriate, and predictable responses, fostering user confidence 
and protecting against harmful or inappropriate outputs.
• Safeguards help meet regulatory requirements and prevent the sharing of sensitive or restricted information, minimizing 
the risk of legal complications.
All
GenAI
• To ensure the responsible and safe deployment of 
the GenAI Embedded Experience we implement a 
custom configuration for content moderation 
• Admin can configure the: denied topic, forbitten 
words, and PII data which needs to be filter on input 
and output

Focus Mode (LA)
User would be able to chat in context of a specific set of agents and 
tools, to be more in context with what is intended to be done by the 
GenAI Assistant. 
• Current GenAI assistants operate in generalist 
mode, forcing users to repeatedly clarify intent 
and scope for each interaction. Agents may 
invoke irrelevant tools, cause contextual drift, or 
take incorrect actions due to lack of domain 
focus.
• By limiting tools to relevant capabilities, Focus Mode reduces the risk of incorrect tool invocation and wasted 
processing. Users achieve faster resolution with improved accuracy and targeted, relevant responses aligned to their 
actual needs.
All
GenAI

able to chat against the limited set of agents

Evaluation (LA)
Evaluation framework allowing to execute the automated test for the 
GenAI Assistant Agents /Tools and prompt by checking the generated 
responses from those service against the ground truth. 
• Currently test of the tool and agents is very 
manual and time consuming. The LLMs are 
deterministic in its nature which makes it very 
difficult to validate the actual output. 
• Migration from manual test-case driven testing for improvements in both test coverage and efficiency.
• Additional flexibility and scalability for automated testing scenarios
All
GenAI
• Admin can configure the topic restriction, forbitten 
words, and filtering for the PII data 
• evaluation validate a given prompt/response against 
a ground truth response and 3 metrics: 
• Answer Correctness – Is the generated response 
accurate?
• Answer Similarity – Does the generated response 
align with the Ground Truth response?
• Answer Relevance – Is the generated response 
relevant to the Ground Truth response?

Recipe Optimization solver in 
the standard catalog
The Recipe Optimization model delivers realistic recipe formulations by 
optimizing across ingredient options and their nutrient contributions, 
enabling more accurate, explainable, and actionable recipe decisions.
• Many optimization use cases require access to 
more specialized and advanced algorithms to tackle 
unique data challenges effectively. 
• Optimization of recipe formulations involves varied 
ingredient availability, and each option has different 
nutritional, cost, or quality characteristics. Reflecting 
the real-world variability to reconcile nutrition 
targets, cost constraints, and supply limitations is a 
big challenge to our customers..
• Supports fast time-to-value through easy deployment from the Optimization standard catalog directly into production 
workflows, with no custom model build or data science knowledge required
• Produces realistic and accurate optimization results by accounting for lot-level differences in availability, cost, and 
nutrient composition
• Reduces formulation errors and accelerates decision-making by enabling confident trade-offs between nutrition, cost, 
and constraints
All
Infor Artificial Intelligence​
• The Recipe Optimization model we are introducing in 
the standard catalog of fast-track quests is very easy 
to deploy in production environments without needing 
data science knowledge. 
• The model enables formulation at the 
ingredient-option level, allowing each ingredient 
option to carry its own availability, cost, ranking, and 
nutrient values. By calculating nutrient outcomes from 
the specific options selected, the model evaluates 
realistic trade-offs across nutrition, cost, and 
constraints, and produces solutions that reflect actual 
supply conditions rather than idealized assumptions.

AI Model Outputs Explainability 
with GenAI
AI models offer significant value through their predictive and 
prescriptive capabilities, yet users struggle to trust the model outputs 
due to a lack of understanding about the underlying logic driving them.​​
• AI models do not provide context and interpretation 
of their responses. ​​
• Due to lack of interpretation and transparency of the 
logic behind the model’s reasoning, the end 
consumers struggle to trust the predictions and 
prescriptions. ​​
• Integration of GenAI will demystify model decisions by providing direct, understandable insights into how predictions 
were made as a narrative explanation that supports user comprehension.​​
• The explanation of model reasoning will bridge the trust gap in AI model outputs, providing users with the clarity they 
need to adopt and apply ML and Optimization insights confidently. ​​
• By providing GenAI explanations, we can deliver a more user-friendly and transparent experience, improving adoption 
and satisfaction with AI model responses. The transparency will empower users to make better-informed decisions, 
increase confidence in automated insights, and drive higher value from our AI offerings.​​
All
Infor Artificial Intelligence​
• Enabling GenAI capabilities for users to access rich, 
explanatory insights into AI model responses through 
the AI Advisor widget. ​​
• Model statistics data need to be generated during the 
ML model training and made accessible to the GenAI 
endpoint, which will then be able to interpret and 
deliver human-readable explanations of the ML 
model’s logic upon request.
• This capability is available for ML models trained with 
custom algorithms​ that are producing the model 
statistics information.

for Agentic experience [LA]
Exposing Infor AI endpoints to be invoked in natural language through 
the GenAI Assistant to provide predictions and insights as an agentic 
interaction.​
• Customers increasingly expect AI-driven insights to 
be accessible through intuitive, conversational 
interfaces. However, most AI models are siloed 
behind technical APIs and lack the contextual 
metadata required for dynamic interaction. This 
creates a barrier for non-technical users who cannot 
easily access or benefit from predictive and 
prescriptive capabilities.
• As enterprise users increasingly interact with 
systems via AI conversational interfaces, the need 
for contextual, AI-driven responses grows.​
• Enabling GenAI to proactively select and interact with models transforms AI from a passive tool into an active, 
intelligent assistant embedded in everyday workflows.
• A seamless, low-friction way to access AI predictions through natural language.
• Reduces the need for technical expertise, accelerates decision-making and increases the usability and impact of 
existing AI investments.

Infor Artificial Intelligence​
• Enabling users to call real-time AI endpoints through 
the GenAI Assistant in an agentic manner.
• The MCP integration layer bridges the gap between 
GenAI and deployed AI models, exposing rich 
metadata through Infor AI endpoint details to enable 
agentic model invocation.
• GenAI uses the metadata to recognize available 
models, understand their capabilities, and invoke 
them appropriately to acquire insights within the chat

Mongoose 2025.05 Release Highlights
The 2026.04 release significantly expands and modernizes the Mongoose Infor 
(Birst) chart component with new chart types, richer KPI/Gauge capabilities, and 
better chart templates. It also broadens where charts can be used by fully 
enabling them on IDS forms while improving reliability on classic forms.
• Stats widget deprecation breaks the current On 
Your Radar pattern.
• Pattern mixes KPIs with tasks, confusing 
informational vs actionable use.
• Raw Notification Center feeds overload users 
instead of focusing “what now.”
• FIFO ordering ignores severity/priority from 
source systems.
• More chart options (Heatmap, Table, Waterfall) support richer visual analysis.
• Gauge charts can now use Critical Numbers, making them better KPI indicators.
• Charts work more reliably on classic forms (Gauge display issues resolved).
• Infor Charts are now available on IDS forms, supporting modern UI adoption.
• Improved chart templates speed up building good-looking, usable charts.

• Enabled Gauge charts to use Critical Numbers

• Fixed Gauge so it renders on classic forms.
• Allowed Infor Charts to be used and bound 
(including to current row) on IDS forms.
• Improved chart templates for better defaults

forms and integrations automatically inherit consistent behaviors (like 
required/read-only, validators, lists) without duplicating form logic.
• Business rules were duplicated across many 
forms and integrations.
• Behavior was inconsistent between UI, REST, 
and other IDO consumers.
• Updating rules required changing logic in 
multiple places.
• Hard to drive behavior from IDO-level 
features/settings rather than form logic.
• Less duplicated form scripting and custom logic to maintain.
• Consistent validation and behavior across forms, REST, and other IDO consumers.
• Easier maintenance, update rules once at the IDO level.
• Cleaner separation of business rules from UI design.

Infor Mongoose

IDO tier.
• Define conditions once per IDO (values, modified 
state, features, settings).
• Apply actions that control required/read-only,

Easily transform and align event values to your data consumption strategy
• Ingested data may not align with destination column 
formats. For example, timestamp fields provided as 
integer epoch-milliseconds, while destinations 
supports standard datetime. 
• Destination structures may require combining 
multiple properties into a single value (e.g., merging 
first and last names or joining codes). 
Reduces the need for transformations at the destination, simplifying processes and speeding up data preparation. The 
result is lower development costs, faster delivery, improved time-to-insight for analytics and reporting, and better decision-
making.
Introduced a new pipeline transformation feature called 
Functions, enabling users to apply simple 
transformations to event values, such as:
• Concatenating multiple properties
• Converting values into standard date and date-time 
formats, which is especially useful for SQL Server 
destinations where ingested integer-based dates or 
timestamps need to be stored in properly formatted 
date and datetime columns.

Data Fabric is integrating with the Auditing & Monitoring service to send 
Data Catalog and Security Profiles audit events

Data Catalog to Data Fabric’s, Data Fabric must 
provide equivalent auditing capabilities to those 
currently used in ION
• Enables traceability of changes and access patterns to support governance.
• Helps detect unauthorized access and supports internal audits and compliance.
• Builds trust in Data Fabric’s metadata and security management, encouraging broader adoption.
